# Headings {#headings}

`#` headings read as in 0.1 (U-043). 0.2 also accepts `=` headings, and `carve fmt` writes them; the roadmap ties this to one heading character in prose and in `|=` header cells, with `#` left to tags ([#1092](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/issues/1092)). The remaining rows are tabs, comments and line endings inside a heading line.

**U-043** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> `#` headings, closing hashes, brace text, seven markers

::: compare no-render
```text
# One
# Two
```
```html
<section id="One">
  <h1>One</h1>
</section>
<section id="Two">
  <h1>Two</h1>
</section>
```
:::

**U-148** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-081,C2-I-084: in 0.1, `# 	%%h` writes `<section id="h"> ⏎   <h1>	%%h</h1> ⏎ </section>`.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
# 	%%h
```
```html
<section id="s">
  <h1></h1>
</section>
```
:::

**U-174** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-027,C2-B-014: in 0.1, `# 	x` writes `<section id="x"> ⏎   <h1>	x</h1> ⏎ </section>`.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
# 	x
```
```html
<section id="x">
  <h1>x</h1>
</section>
```
:::

**U-176** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-001,C2-I-084: in 0.1, `# T ␍ b` writes `<section id="T"> ⏎   <h1>T</h1> ⏎   <p>b</p> ⏎ </section>`.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
# T⟨U+000D⟩b
```
```html
<section id="T-b">
  <h1>T⟨U+000D⟩b</h1>
</section>
```
:::

**U-366** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-H-096 and C2-H-143, a heading that holds a cross-reference to itself: `# A </#A>`

::: compare no-render
```text
# A </#A>
```
```crv
{#A}
= A [A A ](#A)
```
:::
